rabbi-shimon-ben-elyakim.name: Rabbi Shimon ben Elyakim
rabbi-shimon-ben-elyakim.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who appears in discussion with Rabbi Elazar.
rabbi-shimon-ben-elyakim.prompt: A keen-eyed scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a questioning, slightly raised brow, as one ready to raise an objection, in a cream wool mantle, background Galilean limestone arches and olive trees of Tiberias.

rav-anan.name: Rav Anan
rav-anan.bio: Babylonian Amora, a student of Shmuel.
rav-anan.prompt: A careful, practical judge in his 50s with a full brown beard touched with grey and a steady, measured gaze, in a dark wool mantle over a linen robe, background mudbrick academy walls of Neharde’a lit by oil lamps.
